# The options schema is assembled per target: sngl:std's Options are global,
# while a platform's or language's own Options are in scope only for a build
# selecting it. Guards the tier split — every platforms/ and languages/ package
# declares an `Options`, so a merged scan of the library would hand one of
# theirs to every target.
sngl check ok.sngl
stdout 'ok'

! sngl check platform_leak.sngl
stderr 'unknown option "stylesheet"'

! sngl check lang_leak.sngl
stderr 'unknown option "goVersion"'

-- ok.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output {
    none {
        html(name="Demo", icon="favicon.png", stylesheet="app.css")
    }
    go {
        bubbletea(goVersion="1.23")
    }
}

component main {
    text(value="hello")
}

-- platform_leak.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea(stylesheet="app.css")
    }
}

component main {
    text(value="hello")
}

-- lang_leak.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output {
    none {
        html(goVersion="1.23")
    }
}

component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
